summary: Authored and then independently re-verified the v8 deep content: 37 new records + 6 enrichments (43 ids total) across 4 new and 3 modified data files, 23 registry rows (183->206), 43 curated webRefs, and docs/CONTENT_INVENTORY.md section 11 documenting all of it. Categories: (1) CORTICAL FUNCTIONAL AREAS 12/12 in src/data/structures/telencephalon-cortical-areas.json - kind context, subdivision 'Functional cortical areas', ids ctx-v1 ctx-v2 ctx-a1 ctx-a2 ctx-wernicke ctx-broca ctx-m1 ctx-s1 ctx-premotor ctx-sma ctx-entorhinal ctx-frontal-eye-fields, each with the new optional field anchors {gyrus, mesh} documented in the file header, plus function/connections/bloodSupply/clinical/levels/refs (V1 = striate cortex on the calcarine banks, PCA calcarine branch, cortical blindness with macular sparing + Anton; A1 = Heschl transverse temporal gyri, bilateral deafness; Wernicke = fluent aphasia; Broca = non-fluent; M1/S1 = motor/sensory deficit; entorhinal = anterior parahippocampal, perforant-path origin). anchors.mesh is ctx-hemisphere-l for all 12 because BodyParts3D has no per-gyrus mesh and the ribbon answers clicks as ctx-cerebral-cortex (SceneLayers TEL_HEMISPHERE_RECORD_IDS) - stated in each contextNote and in inventory 11.2. (2) BASAL GANGLIA 3 new (nuc-accumbens, nuc-ventral-pallidum, nuc-claustrum appended to telencephalon-basal-ganglia.json) with shell/core reward roles, limbic-loop connections and addiction/hedonic clinical. DEVICE FROM THE BRIEF, stated: GPi and GPe were NOT re-authored - nuc-globus-pallidus-internus/externus already exist, are registered and authored, and already state the direct-pathway (GPi) and indirect-pathway (GPe) roles the brief asks for; inventing nuc-gpi/nuc-gpe would have produced duplicate ids AND duplicate display names, which are hard validator errors. Net coverage of the five named structures: GPi existing-verified, GPe existing-verified, accumbens new, ventral pallidum new, claustrum new (inventory 11.4). (3) HIPPOCAMPAL FORMATION 4 new in telencephalon-hippocampal-subfields.json (nuc-subiculum, nuc-ca1, nuc-ca2-ca3, nuc-ca4) + nuc-dentate-gyrus enriched - all meshes:false with an 'Authored structure - schematic placement' contextNote, trisynaptic circuit stated, CA1 most vulnerable to hypoxia, mesial temporal sclerosis/epilepsy clinical. (4) OPTIC PATHWAY 3 new in telencephalon-optic-pathway.json (tract-optic-nerve, ctx-optic-chiasm, tract-optic-tract) + tract-optic-radiation enriched (levels extended) - retina->nerve->chiasm->tract->LGN->radiation->V1, bitemporal hemianopia, incongruous hemianopia, quadrantanopias. (5) VENTRICULAR SEGMENTS all 5 present (1 new vent-lateral-ventricle-body + the 4 existing horn/atrium records enriched with measured origin3d/size3d and the splitter planes z=+25, z=-6, z=-24, y=+22 documented in their contextNote); vent-interventricular-foramen already existed. (6) VASCULATURE 14 records staged in src/data/structures-pending/vasculature.json, region 'vasculature', kind 'vessel', ids aligned to the authoritative docs/VASC_INVENTORY.md: vasc-internal-carotid-artery, -vertebral-artery, -basilar-artery, -anterior-cerebral-artery, -anterior-communicating-artery, -middle-cerebral-artery, -posterior-communicating-artery, -posterior-cerebral-artery, -superior-cerebellar-artery, -anterior-inferior-cerebellar-artery, -posterior-inferior-cerebellar-artery, -lenticulostriate-arteries, -anterior-choroidal-artery, -posterior-medial-choroidal-artery; each with territory[] (real existing structure ids), supply[] (real existing syndrome-card ids: PCA -> syn-dejerine-roussy/percheron, AICA -> syn-lateral-pontine, SCA -> syn-cerebellar, PICA/vertebral -> syn-lateral-medullary), function, clinical (what an infarct causes), L/R laterality, crimson colour family, levels, origin3d/size3d, refs and the verified BP3D mesh files. STAGED, NOT LOADED, because region 'vasculature' is not yet in the validator REGIONS / types.ts Region / load.ts ALL_REGIONS (the vasc-region-platform task's scope; this task was told NOT to edit src/types.ts or scripts/validate-data.mjs). Landing is 3 mechanical steps with zero edits to the records: add the enum ('Cerebral vasculature'), register the 14 ids, git mv to src/data/structures/telencephalon-vasculature.json (inventory 11.8). (7) WEB REFS 43 curated entries in src/data/webRefs.ts, incl. every vessel (getWebRefs() emits no automatic fallback for kind 'vessel'), with journal DOIs verified against Crossref. RESULT: npm run validate exit 0 - 0 errors, and exactly 1 warning, which is the intentionally staged vessel file being 'parsed only'; npm run check (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; npm run verify:pipeline exit 0 at the unchanged v7 baseline 106/106 parts / 570,096 triangles / 329 loops / 0 problems. The staged warning is INHERENT TO THE BRIEF-MANDATED PATH and cannot be removed by renaming: I proved that validate-data.mjs classifies by path prefix (f.startsWith('structures/')), so any filename inside src/data/structures-pending/ warns; a speculative rename to structures-...-vasculature.json was tried and REVERTED (file byte-identical, sha256 318ae8c099b0977f2be890f54028f72b2d1ef4522f32a846b86d438c0f86ac2b). Moving the records out of src/data would dodge the warning but violates the brief's staging instruction, so the warning is left to disappear when the integration task performs the git mv after the enum lands. INDEPENDENT RE-VERIFICATION (this resumed pass did not trust the first pass's prose): .dsh-scratch/v8-content/verify-content-authoring.mjs is a brief-shaped acceptance gate - 453 assertions, 0 failures - covering per-category counts, the exact brief ids, kind/subdivision/region on every new record, the named clinical facts, level-id resolution, territory/supply id resolution, webRef coverage and registry state. Since Node cannot spawn git in this sandbox (spawnSync git EPERM), .dsh-scratch/v8-content/git-dump.ps1 + split-head-records.mjs dump HEAD's committed v1-v7 data (183 records from 12 files) as per-record JSON and the verifier compares by id, proving the 'nothing below y=+45 moved' claim instead of asserting it: every committed record still exists, NO committed numeric value changed, levels.json anchors unchanged in count and value, registry append-only (+23, no committed row mutated), and the only pre-existing records that gained anything are exactly the disclosed ones (nuc-dentate-gyrus; the four ventricular horns/atrium; tract-optic-radiation levels). Also fixed a real bug in the first pass's own check script: check-v8-records.mjs declared 'const note' over the module-level note() reporter inside the mesh-less honesty branch, so a mesh-less-without-flag failure would have been silently swallowed; the branch now uses placementNote and the message names the offending id. No file outside this task's write scope was modified (git status verifies; git diff --check is clean). Browser lanes not run and not claimed - Chrome is sandbox-denied for agents; what the orchestrator should check is stated in inventory 11.11. FINAL PASS RE-VERIFICATION (fresh, after resume): verify-content-authoring.mjs re-run exit 0 (453 passed, 0 failed), npm run validate exit 0 (0 errors, 1 warning = the intentionally staged structures-pending/vasculature.json only), npm run check exit 0 clean; workspace re-inspected and all evidence-contract files confirmed non-empty; no edits were needed this pass - the resumed state is exactly as reported above and stands verified.
